fields.help_en:
The rule expression in JSON string format.

Example of the rename rule (Rename): {"expression":"${srcDatasourceName}_${srcDatabaseName}_0922","variables":[{"variableName":"srcDatabaseName","variableRules":[{"from":"fromdb","to":"todb"}]}]}

expression: the expression for the rename transformation rule. Supported variables in the expression include: ${srcDatasourceName} (source data source name), ${srcDatabaseName} (source database name), and ${srcTableName} (source table name).
variables: the generation rules for each variable in the rename transformation rule expression. The default value of the parameter is the original value of the corresponding meaning at the source. You can define a set of character string replacement rules to rewrite the original value as needed. variableName: the variable name, excluding ${}. variableRules: the variable generation rule group, which performs replacements in sequential execution. from: the original character string. to: the replaced character string.
Example of the rule to add a specified column and assign a value at the destination (AddColumn): {"columns":[{"columnName":"my_add_column","columnValueType":"Constant","columnValue":"123"}]}

If not specified, the default rule is not to add columns or perform replication.
columnName: the name of the appended column.
columnValueType: the value type of the appended column, including Constant (constant) and Variable (variable).
columnValue: the value of the appended column. When valueType is Constant, value is a custom constant of the character string type. When valueType is Variable, value is a built-in variable. Valid values for built-in variables include: EXECUTE_TIME (execution time, Long type), DB_NAME_SRC (source database name, character string type), DATASOURCE_NAME_SRC (source data source name, character string type), TABLE_NAME_SRC (source table name, character string type), DB_NAME_DEST (destination database name, character string type), DATASOURCE_NAME_DEST (destination data source name, character string type), TABLE_NAME_DEST (destination table name, character string type), and DB_NAME_SRC_TRANSED (transformed database name, character string type).
Example of specifying the primary key column names for the destination table (DefinePrimaryKey): {"columns":["ukcolumn1","ukcolumn2"]}

If not specified, the source primary key columns are used by default.
When the destination is an existing table: the Data Integration system does not modify the destination table schema. If the specified primary key columns are not in the column set of the destination, an error is reported when the task starts.
When the destination uses automatic creation: the Data Integration system performs automatic creation of the destination table schema, which includes the defined primary key columns. If the specified primary key columns are not in the column set of the destination, an error is reported when the task starts.
Example of the DML processing rule (HandleDml): {"dmlPolicies":[{"dmlType":"Delete","dmlAction":"Filter","filterCondition":"id > 1"}]}

If not specified, the default rule is Normal for Insert, Update, and Delete.
dmlType: the type of DML operations, including Insert (insert), Update (update), and Delete (delete).
dmlAction: the DML processing policy, including Normal (normal processing), Ignore (ignore), Filter (conditional normal processing, used when dmlType is Update or Delete), and LogicalDelete (logical delete).
filterCondition: the DML filter condition, used when dmlAction is Filter
fields.help_zh:
规则表达式，json string格式。

重命名规则（Rename）示例： {"expression":"${srcDatasourceName}_${srcDatabaseName}_0922","variables":[{"variableName":"srcDatabaseName","variableRules":[{"from":"fromdb","to":"todb"}]}]}

expression：为重命名转换规则表达式，表达式内支持变量包括：${srcDatasourceName}（源端数据源名）、${srcDatabaseName}（源端库名）、${srcTableName}（源端表名）。
variables：为重命名转换规则表达式中各变量的生成规则，参数默认值为对应含义在源端的原始值，可按需定义一组字符串替换规则对原始值进行改写。variableName：变量名，不含${}。variableRules：变量生成规则组，按顺序串行执行替换，from原始字符串；to替换后字符串。
在目标端增加指定列并赋值规则（AddColumn）示例： {"columns":[{"columnName":"my_add_column","columnValueType":"Constant","columnValue":"123"}]}

如不指定，默认规则为不加列不复制。
columnName：附加的列名称。
columnValueType：附加的列取值类型，包括Constant（常量）、Variable（变量）。
columnValue：附加的列取值。当valueType=Constant时，value为自定义常量，String类型。当valueType=Variable时，value为内置变量。内置变量可选值包括：EXECUTE_TIME（执行时间，Long类型）、DB_NAME_SRC（源端数据库名称，String类型）、DATASOURCE_NAME_SRC（源端数据源名称，String类型）、TABLE_NAME_SRC（源端表名，String类型）、DB_NAME_DEST（目标端数据库名称，String类型）、DATASOURCE_NAME_DEST（目标端数据源名称，String类型）、TABLE_NAME_DEST（目标端表名，String类型）、DB_NAME_SRC_TRANSED（转换后的数据库名称，String类型）。
指定目标端表的主键列列名（DefinePrimaryKey）示例： {"columns":["ukcolumn1","ukcolumn2"]}

如不指定默认使用源端主键列。
当目标端为已有表：数据集成系统不会修改目标端表结构，如果指定的主键列不在目标端的列集合中，任务启动会报错提示。
当目标端为自动建表：数据集成系统会自动创建目标端表结构，表结构包含定义的主键列。当指定的主键列不在目标端的列集合中时，任务启动会报错提示。
DML处理规则（HandleDml）示例： {"dmlPolicies":[{"dmlType":"Delete","dmlAction":"Filter","filterCondition":"id > 1"}]}

如不指定，默认规则为Insert、Update、Delete均为Normal
dmlType：DML操作类型，Insert（插入）、Update（更新）、Delete（删除）
dmlAction：DML处理策略，Normal（正常处理）、Ignore（忽略）、Filter（有条件的正常处理，当dmlType=Update/Delete时使用）、LogicalDelete（逻辑删除）
filterCondition：DML过滤条件，当dmlAction=Filter时使用

The setting name. Valid values:

runtime.offline.speed.limit.enable: specifies whether to enable throttling for offline batch tasks
dst.offline.connection.max: the maximum number of connections at the destination for offline batch tasks
runtime.offline.concurrent: the concurrency of offline batch synchronization tasks
dst.realtime.connection.max: the maximum number of connections at the destination for real-time tasks
runtime.enable.auto.create.schema: specifies whether to automatically create a schema at the destination
src.offline.datasource.max.connection: the maximum number of connections at the source for offline batch tasks
runtime.realtime.concurrent: the concurrency of real-time tasks
